svg.text: every class, attribute and method below exists in the source
Retriever and Answerer have no relationship —
neither imports the other, so no edge is drawn.
It takes all three as parameters rather than
importing them, so each can be swapped in tests.
Exception hierarchy — the only inheritance in the system
◆ filled diamond — composition: the part is created inside the whole and never injected.
◇ hollow diamond — aggregation: the part has a default but can be passed to the constructor.
△ hollow triangle — generalization, pointing at the parent class.
Dashed open arrow — dependency; solid open arrow — navigable association.
